content.title: Brewers vs White Sox score, opening day game recap, highlights
content.text: 5:21 pm CT March 26, 2026Jacob Misiorowski postgame: Brewers starting pitcher reacts to his record dayChristopher KuhagenHear from Milwaukee Brewers starting pitcher Jacob Misiorowski after his 11-strikeout performance in the team's opening day 14-2 victory:5:19 pm CT March 26, 2026Pat Murphy press conference after Brewers opening day winChristopher KuhagenHear from Brewers manager Pat Murphy after his team's 14-2 win over the White Sox on opening day:5:06 pm CT March 26, 2026Brewers highlights vs White SoxChristopher KuhagenSee all 14 of the Brewers runs against the White Sox on opening day:See Jacob Misiorowski's opening day franchise-record 11 strikeouts:4:40 pm CT March 26, 2026Brewers vs White Sox box scoreChristopher KuhagenTeam123456789RHECHW100000001241MIL04022330--141204:33 pm CT March 26, 2026Brewers cruise to 14-2 win over White Sox on opening dayChristopher KuhagenThat's about as impressive of an opening day as you can get for the Milwaukee Brewers.The Brewers crush the White Sox, 14-2, behind dominant pitching and hitting. The two teams get the day off on Friday before resuming the three-game series on Saturday.3:53 pm CT March 26, 2026Jake Bauers makes it 14-1 with booming home runCurt HoggJake Bauers' swing in the seventh may have been the closest a home run has come to scraping the roof at American Family Field. The Brewers left fielder shot a 44-degree slingshot toward right off White Sox rookie righty Jedixson Paez, and the ball just keep creeping toward the bleachers as right fielder Everson Pereira slowly scooched toward the fence.When it landed a few rows deep in the first-level bleachers, it was a three-run homer that pushed the lead to a merciless 14-1.3:35 pm CT March 26, 2026Brewers making life miserable on the SoxCurt HoggIf you wanted an ideal picture of how offense should look for the Brewers in 2026, it's this.They aren't necessarily socking the cover off the ball, but that's okay. Because they are making the afternoon hell on the White Sox pitchers.On their way to gaining an 11-1 lead, the Brewers drew nine walks and one catcher's interference. They faced an incredible 151 pitches.After the Sox pulled stater Shane Smith in the second, they still needed four more relievers just to get through the sixth.3:18 pm CT March 26, 2026Make it 9-1Curt HoggEveryone in the Brewers lineup has now reached base safely as Andrew Vaughn slaps a RBI single to center, scoring William Contreras from second base to push the lead to 9-1 in the sixth.The only Brewers starter without a hit is Garrett Mitchell, who walked and scored in the second.The at-bats from the Brewers have competitive all afternoon, forcing the White Sox to throw 130 pitches through six innings.2:59 pm CT March 26, 2026Your leader in Brewers homer is...who?Curt HoggThat's right, folks. It's Sal Frelick.With a first-pitch, left-on-left sinker at the knees, Frelick lofted the first home run of the season for the Brewers to extend the lead to 8-1 in the bottom of the fifth.Frelick had a career-high 12 homers last year, and most of them looked similar to this one, although with a 106.7 mph exit velocity he got everything he had into the ball this time around.2:43 pm CT March 26, 2026Brewers push lead to 6-1Curt HoggThe White Sox chose to walk William Contreras to get to Christian Yelich and it backfired.With two outs and Joey Ortiz on second base after his second RBI single of the day, Yelich followed an intentional free pass to Contreras by slicing a RBI single to center to push the Brewers' lead to 6-1 in the fourth.2:34 pm CT March 26, 2026Jacob Misiorowski sets an opening day franchise recordCurt HoggThe White Sox have made Misiorowski have to work for it, but they haven't gotten anything to show for it through four innings aside from a Brewers franchise record.With three more strikeouts in the fourth, Misiorowski set a new franchise record for opening day, surpassing the previous mark of eight, set by Ben Sheets and Freddy Peralta.Misiorowski needed the swing-and-miss to wiggle out of a jam after Austin Hays smacked a single and Munetaka Murakami walked for the second time in as many plate appearances. He got a swing and miss on a 99.3 mph fastball to end the frame after getting Everson Pereira on a curveball for the second out.2:06 pm CT March 26, 2026William Contreras delivers the first big blow of the yearCurt HoggWith White Sox catcher Edgar Quero doing all he could to flip at-bats in his team's favor, overturning three called balls in the first two innings, his counterpart did the same with his bat.William Contreras smoked a bases-clearing double with two outs in the fourth, giving Milwaukee a 4-1 lead and chasing White Sox starter Shane Smith from the game. Smith threw 30 pitches in the second, which Chicago manager Will Venable felt was as far as he could go this early in the season.2:03 pm CT March 26, 2026Joey Ortiz gets some sweet justiceCurt HoggA year ago, Joey Ortiz set the Brewers franchise record with 31 plate appearances with the bases loaded, and it couldn't have gone much worse for him. The shortstop batted .167 with a .494 OPS, with nearly all of that damage coming on one grand slam against the Mets.Baseball has a funny way of working.It was only fitting that his first time to the plate in 2026 was with the bags juiced. And given all his struggles in that exact spot last year, Ortiz got a generous break but a deserved one, flaring a 60.1 mph duck snort into right field to score a run and tie the game.1:44 pm CT March 26, 2026Miz strikes out 5 over first 2 inningsCurt HoggMisiorowski settled in right after Meidroth took him deep, striking out the next three hitters he faced in the first and capping the second with a pair of strikeouts. Four of the punchouts came on his four-seam fastball and one was on a curveball.The right-hander has already amassed a whopping 11 whiffs through just two frames.1:15 pm CT March 26, 2026White Sox begin with leadoff homerCurt HoggThat's an auspicious start for the Brewers. After taking Jacob Misiorowski to a full count on the first batter of the season, White Sox second baseman Chase Meidroth launched a no-doubter to left field on a 99.5 mph fastball down the middle.It's the second leadoff homer Misiorowski has given up in his big-league career. Shohei Ohtani hit the other on July 8 last year, but Misiorowski went onto strike out 12 that night.1:11 pm CT March 26, 2026Jordan Love and Jordan Stolz throw out the first pitchesCurt HoggIt was Wisconsin sports royalty before the game as Packers quarterback Jordan Love and Kewaskum native and two-time Olympic gold medalist Jordan Stolz threw out the first pitches.12:41 pm CT March 26, 2026What channel is the Brewers game today?Christopher KuhagenAs a reminder, there are new channels for Brewers baseball this season:Xfinity: Channel 1263Spectrum: 319 or 469DirecTV: Channel 670U-verse: Channel 1743You can stream the games on Brewers.TV at $99.99 for the season or $19.99 a month. Games can also be streamed via Fubo. A free trial is available for Brewers.TV and Fubo.Opening day will also be free on "over the air" TV, broadcasting on Fox in Milwaukee (Channel 6).12:36 pm CT March 26, 2026See Brewers make entrance into stadium for opening dayChristopher KuhagenSal Frelick was dressed to impress with his game-day fit as he entered the stadium. Check out Frelick's fit and others here:12:27 pm CT March 26, 2026Brewers owner Mark Attanasio at opening dayChristopher KuhagenHear from Brewers owner Mark Attanasio ahead of the 2026 season:12:22 pm CT March 26, 2026Jordan Love and Jordan Stolz throwing first pitches at Brewers opening dayChristopher KuhagenIt's a pair of Jordans - Jordan Love and Jordan Stolz - set to throw out the ceremonial first pitches at the Brewers opening day.Love, the Green Bay Packers quarterback, will get the honors for a second time after he threw out a first pitch during the team's Memorial Day game.Stolz, the Kewaskum native is just over a month removed from winning three medals at the 2026 Winter Olympics. The 21-year-old speedskating phenom won two gold medals and a silver in Italy.Love is wearing a No. 22 Christian Yelich jersey and Stolz has a custom Brewers jersey with his last name on the back.11:42 am CT March 26, 2026Christian Yelich says it's 'go time' for opening dayChristopher Kuhagen"Go time."Those were Christian Yelich's words on social media ahead of his ninth season with the Brewers. Outside of Brandon Woodruff, the Brewers' left fielder is the longest tenured player on the roster.Yelich also included a hype video of highlights from the 2025 season with the post on X.The 34-year-old will start as the designated hitter on opening day. It was his primary spot last season.11:33 am CT March 26, 2026Brewers fans hyped for opening dayChristopher KuhagenBrewers fans are packing the parking lots for tailgating and will soon pack the ballpark for opening day:11:32 am CT March 26, 2026White Sox starting lineup vs BrewersChristopher KuhagenHere is the White Sox starting lineup against the Brewers:Chase Meidroth 2BColson Montgomery SSMiguel Vargas 3BAndrew Benintendi DHAustin Hays LFMunetaka Murakami 1BEverson Pereira RFEdgar Quero CLuisangel Acuña CFShane Smith SP10:38 am CT March 26, 2026Brewers starting lineup on opening dayCurt HoggHere is how the Brewers are lining up for Game 1:Brice Turang 2BWilliam Contreras CChristian Yelich DHAndrew Vaughn 1BJake Bauers LFSal Frelick RFDavid Hamilton 3BGarrett Mitchell CFJoey Ortiz SSJacob Misiorowski SP10:30 am CT March 26, 2026Brewers opening day time, American Family Field detailsChristopher KuhagenParking lots open at 10:10 a.m.Gates to the stadium open at 11:10 a.m.Opening day introductions are at 12:45 p.m.First pitch at 1:10 p.m.A post-game sneak peek of a “Ueck” documentary will be shown inside the stadium.10:15 am CT March 26, 2026What channel is the Brewers game on today?Christopher KuhagenThe Brewers game on opening day will be one of 10 free “over-the-air” TV games offered this season.In Milwaukee, the local Fox station, WITI-TV (Channel 6) will broadcast the game. The next “over-the-air” game is March 31.And the team finally announced the channels for cable for games this season after moving off its former distributor to MLB.The club said channels include 1263 on XFinity, 670 on DirecTV and 1743 on U-Verse.For Spectrum customers, the channel varies, depending on the local system – check 308, 1308, 319, 317 and 469 for the channel or channels in your community.A channel-finding tool is on the Brewers website at Brewers.com/watch.10:10 am CT March 26, 2026Brewers finally announce cable, satellite TV channels for broadcastsJR RadcliffeJust before the pitch clock hits zero, the Brewers released a rundown of channels on cable and satellite for game broadcasts, mere hours before the first pitch.The club said channels include 1263 on XFinity, 670 on DirecTV, 1743 on U-Verse.For Spectrum customers, the channel varies, depending on the local system – check 308, 1308, 319, 317 and 469 for the channel or channels in your community.The broadcasts are also listed as available on streaming service Fubo, which offers a free trial for new subscribers.The Brewers are pointing fans to a channel-finding tool on their web site at Brewers.com/watch for a full list.In the moments after the announcement, the channel finder wasn't yet locating details for Spectrum customers for Milwaukee-area zip codes, but that was fixed later in the morning.Streaming customers who used the FanDuel Sports Wisconsin app in previous years can use the new Brewers.TV option to once again watch games. The opener is also one of 10 games simulcast on over-the-air channels this season, including WITI-TV (Channel 6) in Milwaukee.Read more about the latest on TV coverage of Brewers games10:08 am CT March 26, 2026Weather forecast calls for rain, winds after game startsKelli ArseneauRain is expected throughout much of the game. Michaela Heeren, a meteorologist with the the National Weather Service in Milwaukee/Sullivan, said showers will likely start around 2 p.m., and continue throughout the afternoon."After those rain showers do begin across the area, we're really looking at continuous rounds of light rain showers," she said. "A couple of isolated thunderstorms are possible, but not super-likely. I would give it maybe a 10% chance of there being a bolt of lightning."Heeren said the rain should wrap up between 5 to 7 p.m., but some models have rain continuing until 9 p.m. in the Milwaukee area.Temperatures will be cooler than earlier in the week, likely hovering in the upper 40s during the game, and falling into the 30s as a cold front moves in and winds become gustier in the evening.Read more about the weather forecast10:02 am CT March 26, 2026Lots open and Brewers fans set up for early tailgating10:00 am CT March 26, 2026Brewers on TV, live streamChristopher KuhagenBrewers.TV is your home for streaming Brewers games in 2026.Here are the packages available: Brewers.TV Seasonal Package: $99.99Brewers.TV & MLB.TV Package: $199.99Brewers.TV Monthly Package: $19.99Brewers.TV & MLB.TV Monthly Package: $39.999:54 am CT March 26, 2026Jackson Chourio hits 10-day ILCurt HoggThe season began with bad news for the Brewers as they announced outfielder Jackson Chourio is going on the injured list with a left hand fracture.The injury initially occurred on March 4 in a World Baseball Classic exhibition, but after aggravating it during a check swing during the Brewers exhibition games earlier this week, an MRI revealed a small hairline fracture at the base of the third metacarpal.Estimated time to recovery is 2 to 4 weeks.Read the Journal Sentinel's complete story here.9:45 am CT March 26, 2026What radio station is the Brewers game on?Christopher KuhagenListen to Brewers games on the statewide Brewers Radio Network, with AM-620 WTMJ the flagship station in Milwaukee. Here's a list of the radio stations.9:30 am CT March 26, 2026What are new foods at American Family Field?Christopher KuhagenThere’s a lot of new menu items for the 2026 season. We got a sneak peek last week:9:22 am CT March 26, 2026Jackson Chourio starts 2026 on the injured listTodd RosiakNot the news anyone wants to see for opening day: Jackson Chourio to the 10-day IL with a left hand fracture. Blake Perkins recalled from Class AAA Nashville.The move is retroactive to March 25, so this seems related to the HBP he suffered while playing for Team Venezuela in the WBC. Chourio scheduled to speak with the media at 9:45 a.m., so there's more to come.9:15 am CT March 26, 2026Brewers vs White Sox starting pitchersChristopher KuhagenThe Brewers and White Sox will both start two young players who are coming off their first all-star appearances in Jacob Misiorowski and Shane Smith.For the Brewers, the 23-year-old Misiorowski will look to carry the momentum from his superb playoff showing into 2026.He began his MLB career had a bang, earning an all-star nod after just five starts, before struggling in the second half of the season. Overall, The Miz posted a 5-3 record with a 4.36 ERA and 1.24 WHIP in 15 games after getting called up in June.Right-hander Shane Smith, 25, gets the ball for Chicago after starting 29 games last season. He had a 7-8 record with a 3.81 ERA and 1.20 WHIP.9:00 am CT March 26, 2026Brewers predictionsChristopher KuhagenAfter winning franchise-record 97 games in 2025 and qualifying fictions guess third straight year, what’s in store for the 2026 Brewers? The Journal Sentinel’s Brewers reporters give their fearless predictions:Curt Hogg: 89-73, NL Central champions, lose in NL Wild Card roundTodd Rosiak: 90-72, NL Wild Card spot, advance to NL Division SeriesJR Radcliffe: 86-76, miss playoffs (barely)8:48 am CT March 26, 2026Welcome to opening day!Curt HoggThis is Brewers beat reporter Curt Hogg checking in from American Family Field! Grab a seat, a cold one and follow along with our live blog all morning and afternoon. We'll take you into the clubhouse (well, not literally, I'd lose my credential over that), interview room and through the game. Let's have ourselves a day, shall we?8:45 am CT March 26, 2026Who are the Brewers players in 2026?Christopher KuhagenCheck out the Brewers’ opening day roster in photos:8:40 am CT March 26, 2026Brewers opening day rosterChristopher KuhagenHere is the Brewers’ opening day roster:Catcher: William Contreras, Gary SánchezFirst base: Jake Bauers, Andrew VaughnSecond base: Bruce TurangShortstop: Joey OrtizThird base: David Hamilton, Luis RengifoOutfielders: Jackson Chourio, Sal Frelick, Brandon Lockridge, Garrett Mitchell, Christian YelichStarting pitching: Jacob Misiorowski, Chad Patrick, Brandon Sproat, Kyle Harrison, Brandon WoodruffRelief pitchers: Aaron Ashby, Grant Anderson, DL Hall, Jared Koenig, Trevor Megill, Abner Uribe, Jake Woodford, Angel Zerpa8:30 am CT March 26, 2026What time is the Brewers game today? Opening day start timeChristopher KuhagenTime: 1:10 p.m.Date: Thursday, March 26The Brewers play the White Sox at 1:10 p.m. in the season and home opener at American Family Field.8:20 am CT March 26, 2026Brewers 2025 season in reviewChristopher KuhagenThe Brewers had a magical season in 2025, setting a franchise record with 97 wins and also the longest winning streak in team history, a division title 3-peat and a playoff series win. There were so many noteworthy moments from walk-off grand slams and home runs to insane comebacks to an electric postseason victory over the Chicago Cubs.Relive the year and what made it so special through these photos:8:10 am CT March 26, 2026Brewers scheduleChristopher KuhagenThe Brewers open the season with two home series.
